text:
Priya (Product): Quick heads-up — launching the Private Appliance (air-gapped/on‑prem) BETA for a small set of customers next Tuesday 03/23. This contains: image + installer, offline license activation flow, and a compliance pack (SOC2 + FIPS notes). Onboarding is gated — customers need an approved intake form and an SSO/KMS decision. Please read the runbook: https://internal.redwood/priv-appliance/runbook (internal).

Sam (Eng Runtime): Nice. What build are we shipping? any kernel/module requirements for the GPU nodes?

Priya (Product): We’re shipping build 2026.03.15-rc3. Runtime notes: recommended RHEL8/CentOS8 or Ubuntu 22.04; NVidia driver 525+; we surface a small kernel module for nvlink perf tuning but it’s optional. Full compatibility matrix in the runbook.

Liu (Security): For the customers in scope (gov / healthcare), we need a FIPS mode checklist and HSM integration instructions. Who owns the compliance doc?

Priya (Product): Liu — can you own the FIPS checklist? We have a draft in the compliance repo; I’ll link it in the runbook and tag you for review.

Nadia (Solutions Eng): Are we running a customer onboarding webinar? Need slides and an install demo. Also: are Solutions Engs expected to do the on-site install or remote assisted only?

Priya (Product): Yes — onboarding webinar Wed 03/24 10:00 PT (recorded). Two slots for assisted installs the following week. For enterprise customers we offer remote-assisted as default; on-site is by exception and requires ops approval. I uploaded a draft deck: https://internal.redwood/priv-appliance/deck-v1

deploy-bot: appliance-image-build-2026.03.15-rc3 succeeded :white_check_mark:
build id: 14a7c3f
artifacts: appliance-image-2026.03.15.tar.gz

Sam (Eng Runtime): Thanks — I’ll post a short install checklist for on-call and an unattended install example. Example (unattended install):

```
# unpack image
sudo tar -xzf appliance-image-2026.03.15.tar.gz -C /opt/redwood
# run installer (silent)
sudo /opt/redwood/installer/install.sh --offline --license /tmp/license.jwt
```

Sam (Eng Runtime): Also tagging @eng-oncall — expect a short spike in support tickets first 48 hours after onboarding.

Liu (Security): I’ll prepare the FIPS attestation + HSM integration doc by EOD Monday. Also: add guidance on key rotation in air-gapped mode.

Priya (Product): Great. Action items: 1) Liu — FIPS & HSM docs, 2) Sam — unattended install + runbook updates, 3) Nadia — webinar + runbook slides, 4) Eng Oncall — standby 03/23–03/26. I’ll open a shared checklist and invite owners. Please RSVP to the webinar and add any blocking items to the checklist. If any tenant requires SOC2 + additional contractual terms, ping me directly.

Nadia (Solutions Eng): RSVP'd. Will update slides with the demo script.

Sam (Eng Runtime): Will push the unattended installer docs to the runbook by EOD Mon.

Priya (Product): Thanks everyone — big moment for Private customers. If you see risky items, call them out in the checklist. Otherwise, expect customers to start onboarding next week. :rocket: For questions after this thread, use #support-private or DM me.
